channel.title: GTA6 PC news
channel.description: GTA 6 PC release date, leaks, ports and guides.

item.title: Will GTA 6 on PC Support Keyboard and Mouse? What We Know So Far
item.description: GTA 6 has no native keyboard and mouse support on PS5 or Xbox, and there is no PC version yet. The only way to play with a keyboard and mouse on a PC today is Remote Play with a mapping tool, and the mouse only imitates a controller stick.

item.title: The $200 GTA 6 PC Scam Kit: What NordVPN Found and How the Fake Downloads Work
item.description: NordVPN found a ready-made $200 kit on the dark web that bundles a fake GTA 6 PC download with a cookie stealer, a crypto wallet drainer, a hidden miner and a YouTube Shorts bot. Here is what is inside it and how its campaigns reach victims.

item.title: AnyXboxX Neptune: The Xbox Emulator Fork Running GTA 6 at 14 to 17 FPS on PC
item.description: AnyXboxX is the Xbox Series X emulator fork in the GTA 6 PC port race. Its Neptune build reports 14 to 17 fps on an RTX 4070 SUPER, but it needs 32 GB of memory and the leaked Xbox build to run at all.

item.title: Will GTA 6 Support VR on PC? No VR Mode, No VR Mod, Only a Virtual Screen
item.description: GTA 6 has no VR mode and no VR mod, and Rockstar has announced nothing for headsets. The only way to play it in a headset today is the flat game on a virtual screen through PS VR2 Cinematic Mode or Quest Remote Play.

item.title: GTA 6 PC in March 2027? The GameGPU Claim and the Fake Online Press Release
item.description: GameGPU claims GTA 6 reaches PC in March 2027 with GTA 6 Online on the same day, and a fake AI-made press release says the same thing. Here is what each claim is actually based on, and why neither is an announcement.

item.title: Is GTA 6 Playable on PC Yet? What 'Playable' Means in the Port Race
item.description: Six unofficial builds have reached interactive gameplay on PC, and one cleared the prologue at 1 to 3 fps. Here is what 'playable' means on the PortWatch tracker, why 1 to 3 fps is not playing, and what is still missing.

item.title: GTA 6 on PC Gets Ray-Traced Lighting: DexNom, Belobug and the 13 FPS Forks
item.description: The AMD forks of VIctory now run GTA 6 with experimental ray-traced lighting on PC, and a combined fork reports 13 to 22 fps. The game is still far from playable, and every figure comes from single-machine tests.

item.title: Will Take-Two Shut Down Every GTA 6 PC Port? What Happens After Leonida
item.description: Take-Two disabled 3,007 repositories to kill Leonida, and it has a history of suing fan rebuilds. Here is what the takedown means for VIctory and the other port projects, and why the race is going private.

item.title: GTA 6 PC Port Update, Nov 25: Forks Hit 12 FPS as Take-Two Takes Down 3,007 Repos
item.description: One day after in-game rendering, GTA 6 PC forks report 5 to 12 fps and a 77-minute play session. Take-Two answered with a DMCA takedown of the Leonida network, 3,007 repositories in total.

item.title: Will GTA 6 Support Ultrawide on PC? 21:9 and 32:9 Explained
item.description: Rockstar has not confirmed ultrawide support for GTA 6 on PC yet. Here is what its last PC ports did, what 21:9 and 32:9 would cost in performance, and what to expect.

item.title: Will GTA 6 Run at 120fps on PC? High Refresh Rates Explained
item.description: Consoles are capped at 30fps, but a PC version should not be. Here is why the CPU is the real limit, what Rockstar's last PC ports did, and what your PC would need for 120fps.

item.title: Is GTA 6 on Mac? The Real Status, the Viral Clips, and How to Play
item.description: No Mac version of GTA 6 exists, and Rockstar has not announced one. Here is what the viral Mac clips really show, the only legitimate way to play on a Mac today, and the route a future PC version could open.

item.title: GTA 6 Reaches In-Game Rendering on PC, a Day After the Xbox Executable Leak
item.description: One day after the missing GTA 6 Xbox executable leaked, the unofficial PC port projects moved past the menus. VIctory now renders in-game graphics, and a private build called CGBJ reportedly lets a player move and talk to NPCs. Nothing is playable yet.

item.title: GTA 6 PC Port Tracker: How Portwatch Scores the Race to Play on PC

item.title: Can You Transfer Your GTA 6 Save from PS5 or Xbox to PC?

item.title: Will GTA 6 on PC Support DLSS and FSR? What Rockstar's Last PC Port Tells Us
item.description: Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA 6, so DLSS and FSR support is not confirmed. But GTA 5 Enhanced, Rockstar's most recent PC release, shipped with Nvidia DLSS 3, AMD FSR 1 and 3, and Intel XeSS. That is the best evidence for what GTA 6 on PC will offer.
